items.title: Fusion Arabesque and Greek Key Medallion Gate File for Laser Cut
items.description: A sophisticated cross-cultural design pairing a full-coverage Islamic geometric star pattern background with a prominent central oval medallion. The medallion is outlined with a bold Greek Key (meander) border, enclosing elegant, fluid classical scrolling vines in the center.
